title: Bruce demo — project and progression plan

checkpoint.meaning: Main support checkpoint; intake recovered separately. No deployment or owner game acceptance inferred.

scope.game: Bruce explores a comic, fourth-wall-aware Demo across connected scrolling locations and a clue/anomaly countdown.
notes: Tintagel is the selected layout reference; Portmeirion and Clovelly were alternatives.
The cave is the opening board. A05 identifies that cave, not every later board.
The bridge remains broken; repair is not a Demo completion condition.
The reviewed launch bundle is A01–A06. Exact final board counts and creative details remain open.

projectRequirements.title: Start in Merlin’s Cave and climb to the island road
Encounter an impassable bridge and discover the town route
Enable this small studio to produce the demo
Accept and complete a quest; use an item to affect access
Temporary companion joins, helps and leaves

assetRequirements.title: Cave terrain tileset (TST)
assetRequirements.constraints: Original square 32×32 artwork. One tile is a partial contribution, not the full tileset.
assetRequirements.acceptance: Preview/export TST and verify floor, wall and exit edge, numbered slots and board uses.

assetRequirements.title: Bruce walking artwork (TST)
assetRequirements.constraints: Four directions; exact style, frame count and transparency need a brief.
assetRequirements.acceptance: Preview sprite tiles in all four facings.

assetRequirements.title: Merlin’s Cave board (BRD)
assetRequirements.constraints: Uses A01. Authored spawn/layout/collision need a bounded brief; onward transfer is later work.
assetRequirements.acceptance: Preview cave; normal Play spawns Bruce and exercises collision/movement; stable tile slot survives replacement.

assetRequirements.title: Island, cliff and broken-bridge terrain
assetRequirements.constraints: Candidate asset grouping. Exact tile count, bridge representation and style are open. Initial tile route uses 32×32 opaque artwork.
assetRequirements.acceptance: Recognizable terrain and blocked crossing in the agreed route; compatible numbered output.

assetRequirements.title: Town environment artwork
assetRequirements.constraints: Candidate asset grouping; buildings, props and tile count are unchosen.
assetRequirements.acceptance: Owner-reviewed artwork supports the agreed town exploration.

assetRequirements.title: Clue and ending briefs
assetRequirements.constraints: Owner chooses clue structure, dialogue and ending; no invented names or lore.
assetRequirements.acceptance: Trace each selected clue to a response/state change and a chosen ending.

assetRequirements.title: Startup program
assetRequirements.constraints: A startup title is optional and does not block A06’s minimum launch.
assetRequirements.acceptance: Normal Play follows the configured startup into the initial board.

assetRequirements.title: Bridge, town and clue interactions
assetRequirements.constraints: Bridge blocks the crossing and town route remains accessible; clue logic follows owner brief.
assetRequirements.acceptance: Exercise discovery order, repeat interactions and return paths without game-specific engine dispatch.

assetRequirements.title: Ending program
assetRequirements.constraints: Ending behavior remains open pending owner choice.
assetRequirements.acceptance: Normal Play reaches the chosen ending and can reset/replay.

assetRequirements.title: Main File and integrated demo bundle
assetRequirements.constraints: Pin exact asset/program revisions; no silent build selection.
assetRequirements.acceptance: Normal Play → agreed route → ending → reset on recorded build; native parity separately scoped.

assetRequirements.title: Optional music and sound needs
assetRequirements.constraints: Need, scope, sources and rights undecided.
assetRequirements.acceptance: Define only if the owner includes audio in the demo.

assetRequirements.title: Board authoring capability improvement
assetRequirements.constraints: Bounded prototype may use synthetic tiles independently of game artwork. Tool completion must be verified separately.
assetRequirements.acceptance: Create/save/reopen a small board preserving numbered tile references; scope a compatible writer before claiming game production support.

assetRequirements.title: Indexed tileset authoring capability improvement
assetRequirements.constraints: Use diagnostic tile inputs to develop C15/C16 without selecting game artwork.
assetRequirements.acceptance: Preserve numbered slots through save/reopen and export/decoder verification.

assetRequirements.title: Four Bruce walking animations (ANM)
assetRequirements.acceptance: Preview all four animations and resolve frames into A02.

assetRequirements.title: Bruce playable character (TEM)
assetRequirements.acceptance: Inspect character and follow all four A03 walking links.

assetRequirements.title: Main project file and launch package (GAM/ZIP)
assetRequirements.constraints: References A04 AND A05. Ending and village are not prerequisites of the initial launch.
assetRequirements.acceptance: Normal upload → Play enters cave; Reset returns to authored spawn.

assetRequirements.title: Cliff approach board and bridge placement
assetRequirements.constraints: Planning-local ID for the recovered ordered addition. Board split remains a proposal.
assetRequirements.acceptance: Climb to fork; left crossing blocked, right leads town; mainland visible; bridge awards no progress.

assetRequirements.title: First scrolling village board
assetRequirements.acceptance: Enter from right road, test scrolling and return transfer separately.

assetRequirements.title: Resident assets and conversations
assetRequirements.constraints: One resident at a time; known cast Loyalis, Rusty, Lami, Jim and Mac. Exact briefs remain open.
assetRequirements.acceptance: Preview resident placement and script links; talk in Play.

assetRequirements.title: Quest item and accept/find/return programs
assetRequirements.constraints: Mac’s Guphen is an example; identity/location/countdown relation open.
assetRequirements.acceptance: Accept → acquire → return → complete exactly once.

assetRequirements.title: Key and access interaction
assetRequirements.constraints: Building and exact key route deferred.
assetRequirements.acceptance: Blocked before key use; accessible afterward; verify transition if used.

assetRequirements.title: Deferred temporary companion
assetRequirements.acceptance: Join, enable an action, leave; exact checks need owner scope.

planningRules.routeLogic: OR between routes; AND across requirements within one route
planningRules.unknownHandling: Unknown inputs, capabilities, willingness, capacity and tool access remain unverified.
planningRules.eligibility: A fully satisfied route with at least one capable, willing person with positive known capacity can start.
planningRules.scheduling: Eligible does not mean scheduled or finishable. Estimates, dependencies, resource allocation and explicit commitments are needed.
planningRules.sameSprintOutputs: Newly produced inputs do not become available until their exact revisions and checks are recorded. Do not bootstrap a dependency cycle.
planningRules.reviews: Review references exact requirement and variant revisions; this plan creates no accepted variants or build selections.
planningRules.scale: One to five unique people; shared people/capacity must not be counted twice.
planningRules.scenarioIsolation: Each scenario is an immutable planning snapshot plus explicit overrides; assumptions do not overwrite baseline evidence.
